exit: 0
--- stdout
Author, check and inspect Open Control Engine sequences.

Exit status: 0 yes (clean), 1 no (error findings, a non-canonical file), 2 error (usage, read, parse or size failure). Reports are JSON on stdout; see the crate README for the contract.

Usage: oce [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  emit      Validate a sequence, then write it as flat CXF
  validate  Validate a sequence and print the findings as a JSON report
  fmt       Print the canonical text form of a sequence
  catalog   List the block classes, or describe one: its ports, parameters, units, ranges and notes
  vocab     Print the text-form vocabulary, the unit scale factors and every code oce reports
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --render <RENDER>
          When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, always, never]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
--- stderr
